inputs.name: auditTypeScriptNaming.file
inputs.description: An AuditFile supplies absolute and relative paths, extension, source contents, line views, rule limits and size for the file under review. These rules use relativePath and, for TypeScript, extension and structuralLines; the SQL rule only inspects paths beginning with db/migrations/, and TypeScript skips paths ending in .types.ts.

examples.contents:
export function getUser() {}
export function Bad_Name() {}

inputs.name: auditSqlNaming.file
inputs.description: An AuditFile supplies absolute and relative paths, extension, source contents, line views, rule limits and size for the file under review. This rule examines only relativePath: it ignores paths outside db/migrations/ and checks the filename stem inside that directory.

outputs.name: auditTypeScriptNaming
outputs.description: An array of naming findings from function-name and scaffold TypeScript checks. It may be empty or contain multiple findings; each finding records the input relativePath, a rule identifier and a message.

outputs.name: auditSqlNaming
outputs.description: An array of migration filename findings. It is empty outside db/migrations/ or when the filename stem is lowercase kebab-case or snake_case; each finding records the input relativePath, rule identifier and message.

examples.message: Migration files should use lowercase kebab-case or snake_case names.
